name: Ultrasonic in Bounds
hint: The ultrasonic sensor provides usable distances from 3 to 400 centimetres for robot control.
instruction: Limit distance comparisons to the supported 3–400 centimetre range and validate boundary readings.

examples.label: Example
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
if <(@mBot ultrasonic sensor [port3 v] distance \(cm\) :: sensing) < (50)> then
say [Obstacle ahead]
end
